name: cache-seer
description: Band with usage, prompt-cache state and idle compaction status, a cold-send guard, optional keepwarm, and an idle compaction that runs before an idle session's cache goes cold.

autoCompact.title: Idle compaction
autoCompact.description: Compact once when the session idles, while the cache is still warm, so coming back is cheap. On by default; runs ahead of Claude Code's own idle compaction where that is on too.

keepAwake.title: Keep awake
keepAwake.description: Hold the machine out of idle sleep while an idle compaction or keepwarm still waits on a warm cache, then let it sleep. `/cache-seer awake on|off` overrides this.

compactAfter.title: Idle compaction after
compactAfter.description: Idle time before it compacts: auto is 55m on a 1h cache (52m where Claude Code's own idle compaction is on too) and 4m on a 5m cache.

usageShows.title: Usage shows
usageShows.description: Show each usage window as percent used, the way Claude does, or as percent left, the way Codex does. Colours and LOW follow what is left either way.

guard.title: Cold-send guard
guard.description: Before a message that re-writes a large cold cache: ask, log the estimate, or do nothing.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: The cache lifetime this session runs on: 1h on included subscription usage, 5m on most API-key sessions.

minTokens.title: Large-context floor
minTokens.description: Context size, in tokens, below which neither idle compaction nor the guard acts.
